name: Modal
description: An interruptive dialog that requires deliberate focus management.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements in Modal Dialog templates before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Default
examples.notes: Use semantic landmarks and tokenized styling.

behavior.keyboard: Native dialog behavior handles focus; the optional layer explicitly restores focus, traps Tab, and handles Escape.
behavior.dismissal: Use a real close button or form method=dialog; do not make the backdrop the only dismissal path.
